AWS 9mm Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your AWS 1911 into 9x19mm.
A weaker but much more accurate round fired faster than you could imagine!
Comes in a 20 round magazine, and an extra spare mag!

103 5.56 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your AK-103 into 6.5mm Grendel.

Improves recoil, velocity, and penetration characteristics but has somewhat worse body damage.

AR 20 Tact Conversion.info:
Load your Diemaco rifle with .20 Tactical.
Uses the classic 20-round magazines! Increases overall bullet performance, rewards accuracy. But you'll be punished if shots are missed.

K1A 7.62x39 Conversion.info:
Loads your K1A with 7.62x39mm.
Compared to the DR-300, this is a modification to your K1A which through some clever machining, makes it the MAX-III, allowing it to feed the same 7.62x39 magazines coming with the same flaws as the DR-300 in its design.

S-12 762 Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12 with 7.62x39mm.
 Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

AutoMag .45 WinMag Conversion.info:
Load your AutoMag with .45 Winchester Magnum.
This makes your AutoMag III into the .45 caliber AutoMag IV. A more traditionally performing handgun cartridge with a lot of power still by comparison.

376 SCOUT.info: Change the ammunition fired from your Scout rifle into 9.5x59mmRB for big game hunting. This larger bore round is much more potent in closer engagements, and increases muzzle velocity. However, magazine capacity is severely reduced and rounds must be reloaded manually.

S-12 Full-Auto Conversion.info:
Change the internals of your Saiga-12 to make it able to fire in full automatic!
Extremely fast fire rate but hard to control!
Loses out on accuracy and damage range.

Mosin 8mm Conversion.info: A rare Stalowan / Alpenstahlan conversion that allows your Mosin-Nagant to fire the larger 8x50mmR Mannlicher cartridge, increasing the power enough to stop a man up to a decently far range. But the cartridge faults allow it to not keep standard sniper rifle traits too well.

K2 7.62x39 Conversion.info:
Loads your K2 with 7.62x39mm.
This turns your K2 into the rare civillian DR-300. This civilian rifle never really took off during its time, with faults being due to the cartridge it fires.

Gyrojet 12mm Rockets.info:
12mm Rockets introduced with the Gyrojet Mark II.
This makes your Gyrojet load a newer, smaller .49 caliber rocket. These rockets will fly faster at the cost of a longer activation range. Higher firerate.

Bren 2 7.62x39mm.info:
Converts your VZ.806 to fire 7.62x39mm!
Overall large increase in damage, penetration and suppression but at the cost of your fire rate, bullet speed and recoil!

.17 HMR Blanks.info:
Challenge Mode Unlocked!
Extremely low caliber blanks with pitiful performance, but better handling!
Good luck!

S-12 308 Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12 with .308 Winchester.
 Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

BREN .300 Conversion.info:
Loads your VZ.808 with supersonic .300 AAC Blackout!
Improves close range damage and penetration for reduced damage ranges, muzzle velocity and slightly increased recoil!
Great with suppressors!

S-12 953 Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12 with 9.6x53mm LANCASTER.
Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

1858C Snake Shot.info: Changes your shot load into a special purpose pellet-loaded 44 magnum round. Six almost buckshot sized pellets that are great for putting pesky soldier vermin.

TRG 260.info: A conversion kit to transform your gun into the TRG-22, firing the .260 Remington cartridge. Less power, more maneuverability. Comes with a brand new bolt to make cycling much easier!

S-12 50 Conversion.info:
Load your Saiga-12 with .50 BMG.
 Adjusted performance fitting for th- wait why are you doing this? Like, I get you changed the barrel and everything but... Either way, eat your heart out, AK Guy!

FIVE-0 9mm Conversion.info: Convert your FIVE-0 into firing 9x19mm, greatly increases your magazine capacity at the cost of close range effectiveness. Also increases rate of fire.

Henry 410 Conversion.info:
Converts your Henry 45-70 into the Henry 410, firing .410 bore.
Immense power in close range and good accuracy, but faulters strongly at range.

MUZI Strike-3.info:
Specially made 9x19mm shells loaded with three #1 buckshot pellets. Never made it past experimental stages... Until now.
If you're looking for a bullet hose, this is the ammo type for you.

SVK12E 7.62 Conversion.info:
A rechambering of the SVK-12 for 7.62x51mm NATO, intended for the export market. The SVK-12E foregos the trigger group of the 7.62x54mmR variant for a unique 2-round burst only trigger designed to improve shot accuracy at mid-range through volume of fire. It is dubiously effective.

Somewhat reduced damage, but overall improved recoil control..

TFIX 308.info: Swap your caliber over to .308 Win. Increases magazine capacity, velocity, and treats your rifle closer to a standard light sniper.

.22 Win Magnum (Ruger).info: Loads your .22LR rifle with higher-power magnum rounds, improving performance against the body while reducing it against the head.
